description:
[Original Webtoon](https://bufftoon.plaync.com/series/100871)

**Official Translations:**     
[Japanese](https://www.amazon.co.jp/-/en/dp/B0BW9DV561/) 

Sabbath is a world where everyone from a newborn child to an extremely old man can use magic.  
However, no women can use magic, and they get discriminated against in every way while being called “Unforbal.” “As a representative of Unforbal, I’ll grant you true education!”  
The one and only witch, Rina Sterling, who gets to use magic as Warlock, the president of magician, gives her a crest.  
One day, Rina becomes the only eyewitness of a scene where magicians use magic through human beings, and the begins to get all the attention of the magic world all the sudden…  
The dark and astonishing secrets about Unforbal, Warlock, and magic are about to be revealed.  
(From C&C Revolution Inc.)
